annotation.title_clean: Council Directive 84/529/EEC of 17 September 1984 on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to electrically operated lifts
annotation.title_en: Council Directive 84/529/EEC of 17 September 1984 on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to electrically operated lifts
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 300
annotation.summary_en: 1984 Council Directive harmonising Member State laws on electrically operated lifts. It requires conformity with CEN standard EN 81-1 with modifications, and EEC type-examination of key safety components. It bars Member States from restricting conforming lifts and components. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to permanently installed electric passenger lifts; excludes hydraulic, goods-only and other lift types.
Member States may not restrict installation of lifts meeting the Directive and Directive 84/528/EEC.
Safety components (door locks, overspeed governors, safety gears, buffers) need EEC type-examination, valid 10 years.
Annex I requires compliance with EN 81-1 with specified amendments.
Member States must transpose within 24 months of notification.
